home.title: Penguino | Free Browser-Based Creative Tools
home.description: Create text graphics, resize and optimise images, remove metadata, extract colour palettes, pack files, generate favicons, and compress PDFs with Penguino's private browser-based tools.
home.heading: Free creative tools that run in your browser
home.intro: Create, resize, convert and optimise files with simple tools that keep your work on your device.

text.title: Text Graphic Maker | Penguino
text.description: Create crisp branded text graphics with custom fonts, colours, spacing and export sizes, directly in your browser.
text.heading: Create branded text graphics online
text.intro: Build clean text-only graphics with reusable brand colours, Google Fonts and exact export dimensions.

resize.title: Free Image Resizer | Penguino
resize.description: Resize an image to exact pixel dimensions and download it as PNG, JPEG or WebP without uploading your file.
resize.heading: Resize images to exact pixel dimensions
resize.intro: Resize PNG, JPEG and WebP images by width, height or exact dimensions while keeping control of quality.

convert.title: Free Image File Converter | Penguino
convert.description: Convert images between PNG, JPEG and WebP formats privately in your browser with adjustable export quality.
convert.heading: Convert PNG, JPEG and WebP images
convert.intro: Switch image formats locally with transparency and quality controls where supported.

optimise.title: Free Image Optimiser | Penguino
optimise.description: Compress PNG, JPEG and WebP images locally with adjustable quality, file-size savings and a live before-and-after comparison.
optimise.heading: Compress and optimise images online
optimise.intro: Reduce image file sizes while comparing the original and optimised result at fitted or full-size zoom.

remove-background.title: Free Background Remover | Penguino
remove-background.description: Remove solid and simple image backgrounds locally, refine the edges and download a transparent PNG without uploading your file.
remove-background.heading: Remove simple image backgrounds
remove-background.intro: Create transparent PNG cutouts from images with solid or simple backgrounds directly in your browser.

favicon.title: Free Favicon Generator | Penguino
favicon.description: Generate a complete favicon package with browser icons, Apple Touch icons, Android icons, a manifest and HTML markup.
favicon.heading: Create a complete favicon package
favicon.intro: Generate browser, Apple and Android icons plus a web manifest and installation markup from one image.

bulk-resize.title: Free Bulk Image Resizer | Penguino
bulk-resize.description: Resize up to 10 PNG, JPEG or WebP images together using shared dimensions, format and quality settings.
bulk-resize.heading: Resize up to 10 images at once
bulk-resize.intro: Apply shared dimensions, formats and quality settings to a batch and download the results as a ZIP.

pdf-compress.title: Free PDF Compressor | Penguino
pdf-compress.description: Reduce PDF file sizes locally in your browser with a choice of compression levels and no document upload.
pdf-compress.heading: Compress PDF files in your browser
pdf-compress.intro: Reduce image-heavy PDF file sizes locally with light, balanced or strong compression.

metadata.title: Free Image Metadata Remover | Penguino
metadata.description: Remove EXIF, location, camera and other embedded metadata from PNG, JPEG and WebP images privately in your browser.
metadata.heading: Remove EXIF and GPS metadata from images
metadata.intro: Inspect readable metadata, create a clean image copy and verify common embedded fields were removed.

pack.title: Free File ZIP Packer | Penguino
pack.description: Bundle up to 50 files into one named ZIP archive locally in your browser, with optional filename prefixing.
pack.heading: Create a ZIP archive locally
pack.intro: Bundle documents, images and other files into one named ZIP without uploading them to a server.

palette.title: Free Colour Palette Extractor | Penguino
palette.description: Extract a colour palette from any PNG, JPEG or WebP image, copy HEX values and download ready-to-use CSS.
palette.heading: Extract a colour palette from an image
palette.intro: Discover prominent image colours, copy HEX values and download the complete palette as CSS.

social-resize.title: Free Social Media Image Resizer | Penguino
social-resize.description: Resize and crop images for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and Pinterest using ready-made social media dimensions.
social-resize.heading: Resize images for social media
social-resize.intro: Prepare images for popular social media posts, stories, thumbnails and pins with accurate pixel presets.

pdf-merge.title: Free PDF Merger and Page Extractor | Penguino
pdf-merge.description: Merge multiple PDF files or extract selected page ranges locally in your browser without uploading your documents.
pdf-merge.heading: Merge PDFs or extract selected pages
pdf-merge.intro: Combine complete PDF documents in your chosen order or create a new PDF from only the pages you need.

qr.title: Free QR Code Generator for PNG and SVG | Penguino
qr.description: Create a custom QR code for any URL or message and download it as a high-resolution PNG or scalable SVG.
qr.heading: Create a custom QR code
qr.intro: Generate a styled QR code with colour, margin, size and error-correction controls directly in your browser.

svg-optimise.title: Free SVG Optimiser and Compressor | Penguino
svg-optimise.description: Optimise SVG files, remove unnecessary vector markup and compare file-size savings without uploading your artwork.
svg-optimise.heading: Optimise and compress SVG files
svg-optimise.intro: Clean unnecessary SVG markup and download a smaller vector file while preserving scalable artwork.

watermark.title: Free Image Watermark Tool | Penguino
watermark.description: Add a custom text watermark to PNG, JPEG or WebP images with position, size, colour, opacity and repeat controls.
watermark.heading: Add a watermark to an image
watermark.intro: Apply a custom text watermark to an image and export the result as PNG, JPEG or WebP.

split.title: Free Image Splitter and Grid Maker | Penguino
split.description: Split an image into rows and columns, preview every tile and download the complete grid as a ZIP file.
split.heading: Split an image into equal tiles
split.intro: Divide one image into a custom grid for social posts, carousels, printing or creative layouts.

settings.title: Settings | Penguino
settings.description: Manage your Penguino creative toolkit settings and browser-based preferences.
settings.heading: Penguino settings
settings.intro: Manage local preferences for the Penguino creative toolkit.

about.title: About Penguino | Simple, Free Creative Tools
about.description: Meet Penguino, a collection of free, thoughtfully designed tools for designers, marketers and anyone who wants to get simple digital jobs done.
about.heading: Meet Penguino
about.intro: Learn why Penguino exists and who builds this collection of useful browser-based tools.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions | Penguino
terms.description: Read the terms and conditions for using the Penguino browser-based creative toolkit.
terms.heading: Penguino terms and conditions
terms.intro: Read the terms for using Penguino and understand how local file processing works.
